required_values.name: Codex multi-agent
required_values.guidance: Enable multi-agent in the applicable Codex configuration, or ask your administrator if managed requirements disable it, then start a new session.

config_requirements.name: Codex parallel-agent capacity
config_requirements.guidance: Set agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session to at least 5 in the applicable Codex configuration, then start a new session.

tools.name: Codex CLI
tools.install: Install Codex CLI from the official OpenAI distribution.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade Codex CLI with the package manager used to install it.

tools.name: CodeGraph
tools.install: Install CodeGraph and expose the codegraph command on PATH.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade CodeGraph with its installation package manager.

tools.name: Tokscale
tools.install: Install the latest Tokscale release globally and expose the tokscale command on PATH.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade Tokscale to the latest release with the package manager used to install it.
